title: Takashima Castle

buildingCutout.basis: Named mapped main keep over the stone platform.

terrainReference.basis: Original GSI ground outside the park-side entry staircase.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped keep and retaining wall, Suwa's measured restoration dimensions, native GSI terrain and public-domain photographs of the stone moat and current timber-and-plaster exterior.

note: The Suwa reconstruction guide specifies three stories, a published 20.2-metre height including the 1.7-metre ridge ornaments, a 13.8-metre ground-floor width, and copper in place of original cypress shingles.
